channel.title: South Coast Business Awards 2018 - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from South Coast Business Awards 2018 (dailyecho.co.uk)

item.title: M3 and M27 weekend road closures that drivers will need to be aware of
item.description: Southampton drivers will need to be aware of a couple of closures on the M3 and M27 for the weekend of March 6 to 8

item.title: Plan to transform convent into homeless accommodation is refused
item.description: A controversial proposal to convert a former convent into homeless accommodation has been refused.

item.title: Pre-school promises 'necessary changes' to be made after mixed Ofsted inspection
item.description: Sticky Fingers Spring Road, a Southampton preschool, has promised to make 'necessary changes' after a mixed review from Ofsted.

item.title: Stunning period home with stables and great views on sale for more than £1.5m
item.description: A Hampshire period home with a potential horse-riding business attached is on the market for over a million pounds.

item.title: The 20-year-old hair and beauty firm now employing the baby it was named after
item.description: 20-year-old family run Bella Hair and Beauty in Eastleigh relaunches after refurb with a team including the baby girl it was named after as a hairdresser.

item.title: Gosport leader apologises after 'sexist' remark about mayo
item.description: The leader of Gosport Borough Council has issued a public apology after making a remark about the town’s mayor that was criticised as sexist.

item.title: Former showroom hits market for £975,000 with possible plan for homes
item.description: A former car showroom in Southampton has been put up for sale with an asking price of £975,000, presenting potential for redevelopment after several previous planning bids

item.title: Construction milestone for flagship University of Southampton building
item.description: Construction on the University of Southampton's flagship teaching and learning building has reached its highest point

item.title: Calls for 24-hour street lights as 300 sign petition
item.description: A petition calling for the return of overnight street lighting in Southampton has been signed by 300 people in just under a week.

item.title: Car-ruining potholes on Southampton street have left residents despairing
item.description: Massive potholes on road in Harefield, Southampton, have left residents despairing, as no date has been set for them to be filled.
